changes.to: Kuwa (酷哇科技 COOWA, cowarobot.com) showed D0 with the wheeled X1 at CIIE on 6 Nov 2026, built on the Aether heavy-load platform with quick-change modules for municipal sanitation, last-mile delivery and security patrol, driven by the same COOWAM world model. cowarobot.com's quadruped page lists only the C0 and X0 with a specification table for the X0, so no maker page or figures exist for D0; it may be a rename of X0, but that is not established. No specs entered.

changes.from: Heavy-load all-terrain quadruped on the Aether platform with swappable modules for sanitation, delivery and patrol; shown at CIIE 6 Nov 2026.
changes.to: Heavy-load all-terrain quadruped on Kuwa's Aether platform with swappable top modules for sanitation, delivery and patrol.
